name: koya_lump
desc: Make the flat puddle bulge up into a big, thick, heavy mound of the same glossy brown paint with cream swirls, rising from the middle of the puddle, about half as tall as a person and as wide as the puddle: a lumpy, heaving mass with swelling bubbles on its surface, thick sticky strands and heavy drips running down into the puddle. No face, no limbs. Same colors, outline and pixel art style.
